HenryBraun.

Engineering Manager at Bad Robot Games. Founder of Maned Wolf Games. I build gameplay systems and lead the teams that ship them.

Scroll to load ▾Pittsburgh, PA

15+ years. 16 titles. PC, VR, AR and mobile. From Cartoon Network's Ben 10 to Until You Fall and 4:LOOP for PlayStation, Henry has directed games with Google and LEGO.

Stage 1Player profile

Systems that feel great. Teams that ship.

I earned my B.Sc. in Computer Science from PUCRS at 21, while doing computer graphics R&D at the Hewlett-Packard PUCRS Laboratory. I completed the PUCRS/Ubisoft Game Development specialization in 2011 and my master's in computer graphics in 2012, including time as a visiting scholar at Carnegie Mellon University.

In 2013 I moved to the United States as Co-Director of Interactive Media Initiatives at Vissman Management. In 2015 I joined Schell Games, where I spent more than six years as an Advanced and then Senior Engineer and technical lead on a diverse slate of projects, with a strong focus on VR and AR. I then worked as a Senior Engineer at Twin Suns Corp on Project Octavia, a PvPvE Unreal Engine title.

Today I am an Engineering Manager at Bad Robot Games, where I previously served as Lead Gameplay Engineer, and the founder of Maned Wolf Games.

Stage 3R&D lab

Research

Graphics and simulation research from my computer science and master's years, and the tools that came out of it.

  • Graphics

    A Model for Real-Time Ocean Breaking Waves Animation

    Procedural model that animates ocean breaking waves in real time with minimal CPU and GPU cost, from a small set of parameters.

    →
  • AR

    VRoom 360

    Carnegie Mellon University Entertainment Technology Center project: designed and built an interactive AR survey of vehicle roominess and visibility for General Motors.

    →
  • Graphics

    CrowdVis: A Framework for Real-Time Crowd Visualization

    Framework for visualizing previously computed crowd simulations in real time, with rendering techniques and easy scene and agent management.

    →
  • Graphics

    Large Scale Terrain Rendering

    Analysis of real-time large-scale terrain rendering techniques for games, with a proposal for good visual quality at interactive rates.

    →
  • Graphics

    Generation of Cartoon 2D Cracks Based on Leaf Venation Patterns

    Real-time procedural model that generates customizable 2D cartoon cracks for games, adapted from a leaf-venation method.

    →
  • Computer vision

    Making Them Alive

    Semi-automatic process from 3D posture detection, body-part segmentation, and silhouette processing to an animatable 3D virtual human.

    →
  • Tools

    Phlipits

    Rotoscoping and compositing tool that lets anyone make short animated videos without complex software or long renders.

    →
  • Graphics

    Solar System Simulator

    Astronomy-class simulator where users change mass, radius, and speed of celestial bodies; rendered with OpenSceneGraph or Irrlicht and HDR.

    →
  • Virtual humans

    From Their Environment to Their Behavior: A Procedural Approach to Model Groups of Virtual Agents

    Publication on a procedural approach to modeling groups of virtual agents from their environment to their behavior.
